source: Chapter 674: Manor
target: Capitulum 674: Mansio

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: Upon hearing Rhea’s question, Lumian snapped to his senses and turned to Lugano.
target: Audita quaestione Rheae, Lumian sensum celeriter restituit et ad Lugano conversus est.

source: In his haste to save and “seal” Lugano, he had overlooked Lugano’s condition!
target: In festinatione ut Lugano servaret atque "sigillaret", condicionem eius neglexerat!

source: Ever since this Doctor had gotten his injuries under control, he had been responding to Lumian’s questions.
target: Ex quo hic medicus vulnera sua temperaverat, quaestionibus Lumiani respondere solebat.

source: He was lucid and rational, a stark contrast to the other participants in the Dream Festival.
target: Erat lucidus et rationalis, contrarius prorsus aliis participantibus Festivalis Somniorum.

source: It had to be known that even Ludwig, the monster himself, couldn’t effectively control his appetite and had resorted to devouring humans!
target: Notum erat etiam Ludwig, ipse monstrum, appetitum suum regere non efficaciter posse et homines devorare coepisse!

source: Moreover, Lugano had never slept in Hisoka’s house, nor had he entered this peculiar dream realm before!
target: Porro, Lugano numquam in domo Hisoka dormivit, nec antea in hunc insolitum regnum somniorum ingressus est!

source: Seeing Rhea, Camus, and his employer staring at him intently, Lugano, still grappling with the lingering pain, was utterly perplexed.
target: Videns Rhea, Camus, et patronum suum eum adspicientes intentissime, Lugano—adhuc laborans sub dolore remanente—valde perplexus erat.

source: “Why wouldn’t I be lucid?”
target: „Cur non sim lucidus?“

source: “Aren’t you all still in your right minds?”
target: „Numquid non omnes adhuc in sano animo estis?“

source: Everyone seems to be in the same state.
target: Videtur omnes in eodem statu esse.

source: Why should 1 be the only one with an issue?
target: Cur solus ego problema habeam?

source: Lumian carefully observed Lugano’s emotions and asked in a calm tone, “Have you ventured outside the motel recently?”
target: Lumian diligenter animos Lugani observavit et leni voce interrogavit, „Num nuper extra motel profectus es?“

source: “I did. I assisted Ludwig in purchasing roasted meat and pastries made from palm tree cores,” Lugano recalled.
target: „Feci. Ludwig me adiuvit ad emptionem carnis assae atque placentarum ex medullis palmae,“ memoravit Lugano.

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens erat.

source: “Did you sleep anywhere other than the motel?”
target: „Num alibi quam in motel dormivisti?“

source: No, I wouldn’t dare to engage with the women here.
target: Non, non ausus sum cum his feminis hic agere.

source: Lugano shook his head without hesitation.
target: Lugano caput sine mora concussit.

source: He was evidently a little regretful about this, as there were numerous mixed-blood girls in Tizamo who possessed a different allure compared to those in the Northern Continent.
target: Manifestum erat eum aliquantulum paenitare, quod in Tizamo multae puellae mixti sanguinis erant, quarum decus ab iis in Continente Septentrionali diverso apparuerat.

source: As the two men conversed, Camus and Rhea meticulously searched for any abnormalities in Lugano’s body.
target: Dum duo viri colloquebantur, Camus et Rhea diligenter irregularitates in corpore Lugani quaerebant.

source: However, apart from being sufficiently lucid and lacking excessive emotions and desires, Lugano appeared to be unaffected by the strange phenomenon.
target: Sed, praeter id quod satis lucidus esset et nimis affectibus atque cupiditatibus careret, Lugano videbatur ab hoc insolito phaenomeno immunis esse.

source: Lumian looked at Lugano with a thoughtful smile and said, “We’re being forced to participate in an event called the Dream Festival.
target: Lumian super Lugano cogitantiulo subridens aspexit et dixit, „Coacti sumus ad eventum, Festivalis Somniorum, participandum.“

source: Simply put, we’re dreaming.
target: In summa, somniamus.

source: We can do anything in this dream, but if we die here, we’ll die in reality too.
target: Licet nobis quidquid in hoc somnio efficere, sed si hic pereamus, in re etiam pereamus.

source: “Aside from us, everyone in Tizamo is under the influence of intense emotions and desires, just like Ludwig.
target: „Praeter nos, omnes in Tizamo sub vehementibus affectibus atque cupiditatibus laborant, similiter ac Ludwig.

source: They’re conscious—strictly speaking—but they’ve chosen to show their malice and express their long-suppressed desires.
target: Illi conscii sunt—stricte locuto—sed malitiam suam ostendere atque desideria diu opprimenta exprimere voluerunt.

source: If we can subdue them, we might be able to communicate, but they’ll instinctively try to deceive us.”
target: Si eos subjicere possumus, forsitan communicare valeamus, sed instinctu nos decipere conabuntur.

source: Remembering how the cafe owner, Bunia, had immediately changed his attitude after being targeted by her arrow and begged for mercy, Rhea agreed with Louis Berry’s judgment.
target: Meminens quomodo cauponae dominus, Bunia, statim animum mutaverit postquam sagittam eius accepit atque veniam obsecraverit, Rhea iudicium Ludovici Berry approbavit.

source: The Dream Festival participants weren’t stupid or crazy.
target: Participes Festivalis Somniorum neque stulti erant neque insani.

source: Their excessive desires and emotions were the main cause of their uncontrollable evil!
target: Eorum cupiditates et affectus immodici erant causa principalis mali eorum incontrollabilis!

source: “I see…” Lugano finally understood.
target: „Intellego…“ denique intellexit Lugano.

source: Realizing what Rhea’s question meant, he blurted out, “Why are we lucid and rational?”
target: Cognoscens quid quaestio Rheae significaret, ille repente exclamavit, „Cur lucidi et rationales sumus?“

source: After a pause, Lugano’s voice lowered as he added, “W-why can I stay lucid and rational?”
target: Post paulum silentii, vox Lugani deminuta est, addens, „Cur possum me lucidum atque rationalem manere?“

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens erat.

source: “We can stay lucid and rational because we entered this special dream before.
target: „Lucidi atque rationales manere possumus, quia ante hunc somnium speciale ingressi sumus.

source: We left marks and auras in certain places.
target: In quibusdam locis vestigia atque auras reliquimus.

source: “As for you, I’m not sure why.”
target: „Quod ad te vero attinet, nescio cur.“

source: As he spoke, he watched Lugano’s face closely, observing the change in his servant’s expression.
target: Dum loquebatur, vultum Lugani atente speculabatur, mutationem vultus servi observans.

source: Lugano said in a daze, his voice tinged with fear, “I don’t know why this is happening either…”
target: Lugano, stupefactus et voce metu tincta, dixit, „Nescio cur hoc quoque eveniat…“

source: Noticing that Lugano remained calm even after his issue was brought to light, Lumian seized the chance to glimpse into his servant’s luck.
target: Animadvertus quod Lugano, etiam postquam quaestio eius manifesta facta erat, tranquillum mansisset, Lumian occasionem cepit ut fortunam servi intueretur.

source: Currently amidst a bloody calamity, Lugano might fall victim to an ailment in the coming days…
target: Inter calamitatem sanguineam praesentem, Lugano fortasse in diebus venturis morbo victima fiet…

source: The first part makes sense, considering Ludwig has just eaten half his arm.
target: Pars prima intelligibilis est, cum Ludwig modo dimidium brachii eius edisset.

source: But what does the second half imply?
target: Sed quid secunda pars significat?

source: Could the Dream Festival span several days?
target: Poteritne Festum Somniorum per plures dies extendi?

source: Impossible.
target: Impossibile!

source: If it truly lasted that long, Tizamo’s predicament would have been discovered much earlier…
target: Si ita diu duraverit, casus Tizamo multo antea detectus fuisset…

source: Does this suggest that Lugano would succumb to an illness during the Dream Festival itself?
target: Num hoc significat Luganum in ipso Festo Somniorum morbo victum futurum esse?

source: An illness similar to death in the waking world, one that wouldn’t be instantly cured even if he awakens and receives the Mass’s blessing?
target: Morbus similis morti in mundo vigili, qui non statim curabitur, etiam si evigilaverit et benedictionem Missae acceperit?

source: Lumian quietly pondered the meaning behind Lugano’s revealed fate.
target: Lumian quiete de sensu fati Lugani revelati meditatus est.

source: Shifting his gaze to Camus and Rhea, he realized that they, too, would soon face a grim and bloody ordeal.
target: Converso vultu ad Camum et Rhea, animadvertit eos quoque mox ad asperum ac sanguineum periculum subire fore.

source: If they failed to navigate it properly, they risked slipping further into peril.
target: Si id recte non tractaverint, in periculum ulterius incidere poterant.

source: As these thoughts swirled in Lumian’s mind, he turned to Camus and Rhea and declared, “I’m taking my servant with us.”
target: Dum haec cogitationes in mente Lumiani volitabant, ille ad Camum atque Rhea conversus declaravit, „Servum meum nobiscum ducam.“

source: It wasn’t an act of kindness or generosity.
target: Non erat actus benignitatis aut liberalitatis.

source: Rather, Lumian feared that leaving Lugano to his own devices, given his inexplicable lucidity and rationality, might trigger the abnormality within him and alter the course of the Dream Festival in unpredictable ways.
target: Immo, Lumian timebat quod, relicto Lugano ad arbritrium suum, propter inexplicabilem eius luciditatem et rationem, an in eo non anomalia excitaret atque cursum Festivalis Somniorum in modis incertis mutaret.

source: Better to keep him close at hand, where he could be monitored and any potential accidents prevented.
target: Melius est eum prope tenere, ubi observari possit et casus potentiales prohiberi queant.

source: If Lugano truly unleashed a dire problem, Lumian could always end his life first, eliminating any future complications.
target: Si Lugano vere magnum malum efficeret, Lumian semper primo vitam eius finire posset, ut ullae complicationes futuras deleri queant.

source: Camus and Rhea exchanged disgruntled glances before conceding, “It’s your call to make.”
target: Camus et Rhea oculos inquinae inter se commutaverunt, deinde dixerunt, „Iudicium vestrum est.“

source: “We must hurry to Twanaku’s house,” Lumian reiterated his earlier proposal.
target: „Ad domum Twanaku properandum est,“ iteravit Lumian.

source: Camus’s gaze drifted toward the cubicle where Kolobo lay hidden, a hint of hesitation in his voice as he asked, “Any idea where Captain Reaza and the others might be?”
target: Aspectus Cami versus cellam ubi Kolobo latuit, cum leviter hesitans voce rogavit, „Quid vobis videtur, ubi Capitanus Reaza et ceteri sint?“

source: “They were supposed to appear beside me when the Dream Festival began, but they were nowhere to be seen,” Lumian admitted, recounting the situation honestly.
target: „Erat propositum eos mecum apparere, cum Festum Somniorum inciperet, sed nusquam apparebant,“ agnovit Lumian, rem sincere enarrantem.

source: Perhaps the dream’s correspondence to reality was imperfect.
target: Forsitan relatio somnii ad rem realem imperfecta erat.

source: The location where each person entered this peculiar dreamscape might be influenced by factors like their understanding, the dream’s state, where they had slept, and myriad other variables.
target: Locus, ubi quisque in hunc insolitum somnium ingressus est, variis factoribus—ut intellectu eorum, statu somnii, loco dormiendi, atque aliis multitudinibus—affici potest.

source: Lumian mused that if he hadn’t maintained his lucidity and rationality, he might have awoken in the master bedroom of the Brieu Motel’s suite.
target: Lumian meditatus est, si lucidem rationem non servavisset, fortasse in cella principali suite Brieu Motel evigilavisset.

source: “Should we try to locate them first?” Camus proposed, a note of uncertainty in his tone.
target: „Eos primum localizare conemur?“ proposuit Camus, voce incerta.

source: Lumian let out a wry chuckle.
target: Lumian risum sardonice edidit.

source: “Why? To engage them in combat?”
target: „Cur? Ad eos in pugnam implicandos?“

source: Neither Reaza nor Maslow had ever slept in Hisoka’s house before.
target: Nec Reaza nec Maslow numquam ante in domo Hisoka dormiverunt.

source: The likelihood of them lacking self‑control and succumbing to malice and base desires was high.
target: Verisimilitudo eorum moderationem carere atque ad malitiam ac crudeles cupiditates succumbere alta erat.

source: When the time came, Lumian might not possess the strength to control the pace and intensity of the battle against such formidable Beyonders as he did with ordinary folk, not without the risk of causing deaths.
target: Cum tempus adveniret, Lumian fortasse vim non haberet ad regendum cursum atque ardorem pugnae contra talia formidabilia Beyonders, ut cum plebe ordinaria, nec sine periculo mortem efficiendi.

source: Camus and Rhea lapsed into a simultaneous silence, neither keen on the prospect of a life‑and‑death struggle with their own teammates.
target: Camus et Rhea simul silentium ceperunt, neque certamen inter vitam et mortem cum sociis suis appetentes.

source: Just as Lumian was about to signal the two patrol team members to approach, Camus gritted his teeth as he declared, “There’s somewhere 1 need to go before I head to Twanaku’s house.”
target: Mox, dum Lumian signum dare paratus esset ut duo milites advenirent, Camus dentes contraxit declamans, „Alibi mihi quid agendum est, antequam ad domum Twanaku ibo.“

source: “And where might that be?” Lumian inquired, raising an eyebrow.
target: „Et ubi hoc esse potest?“ inquisivit Lumian, supercilium leviter elevans.

source: Camus replied in a deep voice, “Palm Manor.”
target: Camus, voce profunda, respondit: „Mansio Palmae.“

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian risu exsolutus est.

source: “You wish to rescue Miss Amandina?”
target: „Visne Amandinam servare?“

source: Camus nodded firmly, a hint of embarrassment tinging his features.
target: Camus firmiter annuit, vultu modico pudoris tincto.

source: “Yes, that’s right.”
target: „Ita, recte.“

source: “You needn’t worry.
target: „Noli timere.

source: This is merely a dream.
target: Hoc solum somnium est.

source: If one is violated within the dream, they’ll only experience a touch of hysteria upon waking.
target: Si quis in somnio violatur, solum levem hysteriam post evigilandum experietur.

source: No substantial harm will befall them,” Lumian stated matter‑of‑factly, his intention not to provoke Camus.
target: „Nullum grave damnum illis continget,“ inquit Lumian, non Camum provocare volens.

source: Camus’s expression remained unwavering.
target: Vultus Camus constanter mansit.

source: “I’m aware.
target: „Scio.

source: But I fear she may not be able to cope with it in her dream state and might resort to drastic measures.
target: Sed timeo ne illa in statu somniorum id tolerare non possit et ad remedia extremas recurrat.

source: It could lead to her demise.”
target: Hoc ad exitium eius ducere posset.

source: Without waiting for Lumian’s response, Camus spoke gravely, “You can proceed to Twanaku’s house first.
target: Non exspectans responsum Lumiani, Camus graviter dixit, „Primum ad domum Twanaku progredere potes.

source: I’ll make my way to Palm Manor and rendezvous with you later.”
target: Ego ad Mansionem Palmariam pergrediar et postea te conveniam.”

source: “By the time you’re done, we might not be at Twanaku’s house anymore,” Rhea cautioned him.
target: „Tempore quo finieris, fortasse iam non erimus in domo Twanaku,“ monuit Rhea.

source: Camus nodded gently.
target: Camus leniter annuit.

source: “I’ve made this decision of my own accord.
target: „Hanc iudicium ex voluntate mea cepi.

source: I’m prepared to bear any consequences that may follow.”
target: Paratus sum omnia consequentia ferre quae sequentur.

source: Lumian locked eyes with Camus, remaining silent for a stretch.
target: Lumian oculos cum Camus coniunxit et per aliquam temporis spatium siluit.

source: Camus felt an indescribable pressure weighing upon him, his mind conjuring the tragic outcomes he might face, but he pursed his lips and refused to retract his suggestion.
target: Camus sensit pressuram ineffabilem super se gravare, dum mens eius tragicis eventibus futuri in mentem evocabat; sed labra contraxit et suam propositionem revocare recusavit.

source: After more than ten seconds of silence, his expression unchanged, Lumian finally spoke.
target: Post plusquam decem secundis silentii, vultu immutato, Lumian denique locutus est.

source: “Let us head to Palm Manor now.”
target: „Eamus nunc ad Mansionem Palmariam.“

source: “Huh? Before Camus could react, Lumian’s hand firmly grasped his shoulder.
target: „Heu? Priusquam Camus reagere posset, manus Lumiani firmiter humerum eius occupavit.“

source: “Simultaneously, Lumian’s other hand darted out, reaching for Rhea’s arm.”
target: „Simul altera manus Lumiani subito se protulit, ad brachium Rhea tendens.“

source: “Rhea’s instinctive reaction was to dodge, but the memory of how Lugano had been transported flashed through her mind.”
target: Responsio instinctiva Rhea fuit ut evitare conaretur, sed memoria quomodo Lugano translatus esset per mentem eius subitaneum lucebat.

source: Her tense shoulders relaxed a fraction.
target: Umeri eius rigidi aliquanto levi facti sunt.

source: “With Camus and Rhea securely in his grasp, Lumian shot Lugano a meaningful look.”
target: „Cum Camus et Rhea secure in manu haberet, Lumian Lugano aspectum significantem dedit.“

source: “Lugano, displaying a practiced ease, approached and latched onto a corner of Lumian’s vest.”
target: „Lugano, solertia exercitata ostendens, accessit et ad angulum vestis Lumiani adheruit.“

source: “In the next second, Lumian’s figure blurred, the haziness rapidly spreading to engulf Camus, Rhea, and Lugano.”
target: „In secundo proximo, figura Lumiani confusa est, et nebulositas celeriter se disseminavit ad comprehendendos Camum, Rhea, et Lugano.“

source: “As Rhea and Camus found themselves surrounded by layers of indescribable colors and formless objects, intense emotions surged within their hearts.”
target: „Cum Rhea et Camus se circumdati reperirent ab stratis colorum ineffabilium atque rerum sine forma, affectus intensi in cordibus eorum eruperunt.“

source: “Could this be the spirit world?”
target: „Num hic mundus spirituum sit?“

source: “Is this what teleportation feels like?”
target: „Num hoc est teleportationis sensus?“

source: “Was this how the great adventurer, Gehrman Sparrow, managed to appear before any pirate at a moment’s notice?”
target: „Num hoc est, ut magnus explorator Gehrman Sparrow, ante quemlibet piratam in uno momento apparuerit?“

source: “Having witnessed Louis Berry’s abrupt disappearance and subsequent return with his servant in tow, Camus and Rhea had speculated that this might be the famed teleportation ability that had become the stuff of legend across the Five Seas, thanks to Gehrman Sparrow’s extraordinary exploits.”
target: Testes habentes disparitionem subitam Louis Berry atque eius reditum cum servo, Camus et Rhea coniectati sunt hanc esse famosam facultatem teleportationis, quae legendaria facta est per Quinque Marias, propter extraordinaria Gehrman Sparrow facta.

source: “It seemed their suspicions had been right on the mark!”
target: Videbatur eorum suspiciones recte perfixae esse!

source: “Matani’s patrol team boasted numerous adventurers among its ranks, and Camus and Rhea were well‑versed in the myriad rumors that circulated the Five Seas.
target: Manipulus praesidiarius Matani inter se multos viatores habebat, et Camus atque Rhea in innumeris rumoribus per Quinque Marias bene erant instructi.

source: “The instant they experienced teleportation firsthand, their bodies departed the dream’s spirit world, rematerializing before a four‑story beige edifice.”
target: Statim, teleportationem experirentur, corpora eorum e mundo spirituum somnii discesserunt, et ante aedificium quattuor tabulare coloris beige rematerializata sunt.

source: “This was none other than the main building of Palm Manor.”
target: Hoc fuit nihil aliud quam aedificium principale Mansionis Palmariae.

source: “In the blink of an eye, Lumian, Camus, Rhea, and Lugano had reached their destination.”
target: In ictu oculi, Lumian, Camus, Rhea, et Lugano ad finem suum pervenerunt.

source: “The manor was awash with cries, screams, sinister laughter, and high‑pitched singing.”
target: Mansio repleta erat clamoribus, stridoribus, risu sinistro, et cantu acuto.

source: “Just over ten meters from the main building, near a garden shrubbery, a mixed‑blood lady’s maid lay pinned to the ground by a group of slaves, her clothes half‑stripped as she cried out in desperation.”
target: Iamdudum, paulo ultra decem metra ab aedificio principali, prope fruticosam arborem horti, ancilla mixta sanguinis a coetu servorum in terram pressa iacebat, vestimenta eius dimidia eruta, dum desperatione clamabat.

source: “She struggled with all her might, but how could she hope to resist the adult men?
target: Omnibus viribus conata est, sed cur potuisset viris adultis obsistere?

source: “She was utterly helpless, pinned down and at their mercy.”
target: Illa omnino erat impotens, compressa atque in eorum misericordia relicta.

source: “Witnessing this scene, the former Public Security Officer, Camus, instinctively yearned to intervene, but he quickly reminded himself that this was a dream.
target: Testis hac scena, pristinus Officialis Securitatis Publicae, Camus instinctive intercedere cupivit, sed celeriter recordatus est hoc somnium esse.

source: Such events wouldn’t truly impact reality.
target: Talia eventa re vera realitatem non afficere possunt.

source: At most, they would result in a certain degree of curable hysteria.
target: Maxime, ad aliquam gradum hysteriae curabilis ducebantur.

source: It would be a waste of time to stop it, audit would only serve to delay my search for Amandina.
target: Tempus teritur, si id sistere conemur, quod tantum moram in inquisitione mea pro Amandina afferet.

source: Moreover, it would be pointless…
target: Porro, id erat vanum.

source: Camus warned himself, forcibly averting his gaze as he ascended the steps into the main building.
target: Camus se admonuit, oculos vehementer avertens, dum gradus ad aedificium principale ascendebat.

source: “At that moment, Rhea, who had been silent for a couple of seconds, turned from facing the manor’s main building.”
target: „Ad hoc tempus, Rhea, quae paucos secundos silentium tenebat, a parte aedificii principali manerii versa est.“

source: “You guys head in first.”
target: „Vos primum intrate.“

source: With her back to Lumian, Camus, and Lugano, she spoke in a nonchalant tone.
target: Dorso versus Lumian, Camus, atque Lugano, leni tono locuta est.

source: Leaning forward slightly, she strode purposefully towards the bushes at the garden’s edge, making her way to the mixed‑blood lady’s maid who was being violated by the slaves.
target: Levis paulo inclinata, iter certe profecta est ad fruticosas limites horti, ad ancillam mixta sanguinis, quae a servis violabatur.
